records.source: ONE WIDGET, TWO OWNERS. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow field the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.context: One widget, two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow microscope field of view the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.translation: EIN WIDGET, ZWEI BESITZER. Eine Segmentierungsvorschau hat vier Dinge, die einen Blick wert sind: das Bild mit den Umrissen darauf, die Label-Masken allein, das Flussfeld, aus dem die Masken zusammengeführt wurden, und die Zellwahrscheinlichkeit, bei der der Fluss geschwellt wurde. Die Live-Vorschau der Maskenerzeugung zeigte drei davon über ein Dropdown; die Plaque-Vorschau zeigte ihre eigenen vier über Registerkarten, mit eigenem Code gezeichnet. Dieses Modul ist die eine Stelle, aus der beide sie zeichnen können, sodass eine Änderung daran, wie eine Zellwahrscheinlichkeit eingefärbt wird, beide Vorschauen gleichzeitig erreicht.
records.review_basis: MT draft edited in AI review

records.label: spacr.resource_log#5
records.source: WHY IT IS NOT VERBOSE LOGGING. Verbose logging only decides which log records are kept, so it has no account of memory to give. The function tracer that it once installed fired on every call and every return, and it cost twenty times the startup. An account taken through a tracer would describe the traced program rather than the real one, which is exactly the program nobody wants measured. So this samples instead: one psutil read a second, on a daemon thread that is never the GUI thread, on an otherwise unperturbed run. Three states rather than a checkbox, because the useful default is not "off" -- the most valuable resource data comes from runs nobody expected to fail.
records.context: Why it is not verbose logging. Verbose logging only decides which log records are kept, so it has no account of memory to give. The function tracer that it once installed fired on every call and every return, and it cost twenty times the startup. An account taken through a tracer would describe the traced program rather than the real one, which is exactly the program nobody wants measured. So this samples instead: one psutil read a second, on a daemon independent execution path that is never the main GUI execution path, on an otherwise unperturbed run. Three states rather than a checkbox, because the useful default is not "off" -- the most valuable resource data comes from runs nobody expected to fail.
records.translation: WARUM ES KEINE AUSFÜHRLICHE PROTOKOLLIERUNG IST. Ausführliche Protokollierung entscheidet nur, welche Protokolleinträge behalten werden, daher kann sie keine Auskunft über den Speicher geben. Der Funktions-Tracer, den sie früher installierte, wurde bei jedem Aufruf und jeder Rückkehr ausgelöst und kostete das Zwanzigfache der Startzeit. Eine über einen Tracer gewonnene Aufstellung würde das verfolgte Programm beschreiben statt des echten, und genau dieses Programm will niemand gemessen haben. Daher wird stattdessen gesampelt: ein psutil-Lesevorgang pro Sekunde, in einem Daemon-Thread, der nie der GUI-Thread ist, bei einem ansonsten ungestörten Lauf. Drei Zustände statt eines Kontrollkästchens, weil der nützliche Standard nicht "off" ist -- die wertvollsten Ressourcendaten stammen aus Läufen, bei denen niemand mit einem Fehlschlag gerechnet hat.

records.source: ``size outliers`` The fraction of objects whose equivalent diameter falls outside ``median ± seg_qc_outlier_mad * 1.4826 * MAD``. Median and MAD, not mean and standard deviation: five pieces of debris inflate a standard deviation until nothing is an outlier any more, which is the exact case this check exists to catch (``tests/test_seg_qc.py`` contrasts the two). *k* = 5 is deliberately loose — real size distributions are lognormal and heavier tailed than Gaussian, so 3 sigma flags a few percent of a perfectly good field. The flag fires when more than ``seg_qc_outlier_fraction`` (0.15) of objects are out there. Heavy tails, mixed populations and segmentation defects can all trigger it; the flag does not identify which is present. Border objects are excluded from every size statistic, exactly as ``diameter._region_diameters`` excludes them, because a truncated object's area is a lie.

records.source: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full plate that is hours. A plate whose segmentation collapsed — a channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone; nobody looks, because looking means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files by hand. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious fields, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.

records.source: ``under-segmentation`` (fused objects) Detected the way :mod:`spacr.diameter` detects it, and for the same reason: **both halves of the signature are required**. The field must be dense enough for fusion to be the explanation (foreground at or above ``seg_qc_foreground_fraction``, default 0.35 — the same number ``diameter.estimate_diameters(fused_fraction=...)`` uses, because it is the same question), *and* the mask must under-count what the pixels support: either one label covers more than ``seg_qc_max_object_fraction`` of the field (0.25, again diameter.py's number), or the Euclidean distance transform of the foreground resolves at least ``seg_qc_split_ratio`` (2.0) inscribed-circle maxima per mask object. Requiring both matters in each direction: a dense but correctly separated field reaches 35% foreground and is fine, while an elongated or hollow object shatters the distance transform into several maxima and is also fine. diameter.py demands a 5-fold seed excess because it compares against raw Otsu components, where a confluent monolayer is one blob; here the comparison is against a Cellpose mask that already separates most objects, and the smallest fusion worth catching — every object being a welded pair — is exactly 2. Large, irregular or confluent biological objects can also trigger the heuristic; confirm boundaries against the raw images.

records.source: ``over-segmentation`` (shattered objects) Two signatures. Absolutely: at least ``seg_qc_tiny_fraction`` (0.30) of the field's objects are under ``seg_qc_min_diameter`` (5 px) across — spaCR's diameter estimator already discards components below 4 px as debris, but these defaults must be adapted for genuinely small objects. Relative to the plate: the field holds ``seg_qc_size_ratio``-fold more objects than the plate median at ``1/seg_qc_size_ratio`` of its median diameter. That knob defaults to 1.4 = sqrt(2) on purpose — two objects welded into one have sqrt(2) times the equivalent diameter of one, and one object split in two has 1/sqrt(2) of it, so 1.4 is the fused-pair / split-in-half signature itself rather than an arbitrary tolerance.

Dieser Regler steht absichtlich standardmäßig auf 1.4 = sqrt(2) — zwei zu einem verschweißte Objekte haben das sqrt(2)-fache des äquivalenten Durchmessers eines einzelnen, und ein in zwei geteiltes Objekt hat 1/sqrt(2) davon, daher ist 1.4 die Signatur des verschmolzenen Paars bzw. der halbierten Teilung selbst und keine willkürliche Toleranz.
